pages.title: Config File
pages.text: A JSON config at **config/betterhorses-common.json** lets you toggle whole systems without removing the mod. Server admins use it to decide what's available on a world.

pages.title: What You Can Toggle
pages.text:
- **Stabilizers** - gliding descent.
- **Medkits** - auto-heal on low health.
- **Hitchposts** - tethering blocks.
- **Hooves** - frost-walk, step-up, and fall-damage perks.
- **Horse Exclusivity** - owner-only riding.
- **Multi-riding** - two riders on one horse.

pages.title: Dummy Mode
pages.text: Items disabled in the config don't vanish - they switch to **dummy mode** and stay craftable as decorative models only. Nothing fires off in the world, but you can still build a display stable.
